premise: Spinosaurus calls out that Pteranodon is flying over, and little Ammonite, deep in the lagoon, wants to see too; she remembers the little air-filled rooms in her shell, lets them float her up to the top, watches the wings go by, gets a wave, and sinks gently back down — leaving Spinosaurus looking for her.
inspiration: Kipling's 'Just So' 'how' pattern, answered truly: how a shell can float.
lesson: What you carry with you can take you where you want to go.
learning: Ammonites had shells with little rooms inside, full of air, that helped them float up and down.

Suddenly he looked up. {spinosaurus:face surprised} [excited] "Look! {pteranodon:enter} {pteranodon:go to sky} Pteranodon is flying over!" High above, she was {pteranodon:live glide} {sfx:glide} gliding by. {ammonite:face sad} Ammonite wanted to see too. But she was so small, and the top was so far away. {ammonite:sparkle} Then she remembered her shell. Inside were little rooms, one after another, all full of air. [curious] And air floats! So she let her shell carry her up, up, up, {ammonite:live bob} bob, bob, to the top. {ammonite:face happy} There went Pteranodon, wings wide, sailing across the sky. [in awe] "Ooh," whispered Ammonite. {pteranodon:face happy} Pteranodon saw her, {pteranodon:live wave} and waved a wing hello! Then, slowly and gently, Ammonite sank back down to her cosy spot. {spinosaurus:live look-around} Spinosaurus looked this way and that. {spinosaurus:face surprised} "Ammonite? Where did you go?" {ammonite:bubble-puff} {sfx:bloop} A little bubble came up, bloop. {spinosaurus:face happy} [happily] "I saw her!" called a tiny voice from down below. "I saw her!"

es-ES.title: Amonites sube a mirar
es-ES.text: {ammonite:enter} {ammonite:go to lagoon} La pequeña Amonites vivía en lo más hondo de la laguna. {spinosaurus:enter} {spinosaurus:go to shore} Espinosaurio chapoteaba en el borde del agua cuando, de repente, miró hacia arriba. {spinosaurus:face surprised} [excited] —¡Mirad! {pteranodon:enter} {pteranodon:go to sky} ¡Pteranodon pasa volando! Allá arriba iba {pteranodon:live glide} {sfx:glide} planeando. {ammonite:face sad} Amonites también quería verla. Pero era tan pequeña, y la superficie estaba tan lejos… {ammonite:sparkle} Entonces se acordó de su concha. Por dentro tenía habitaciones chiquititas, una tras otra, todas llenas de aire. [curious] ¡Y el aire flota! Así que dejó que su concha la subiera, arriba, arriba, arriba, {ammonite:live bob} blup, blup, hasta la superficie. {ammonite:face happy} Allí iba Pteranodon, con las alas abiertas, cruzando el cielo. [in awe] —Oooh —susurró Amonites. {pteranodon:face happy} Pteranodon la vio {pteranodon:live wave} y la saludó con el ala. Después, despacito, muy despacito, Amonites volvió a bajar a su rincón. {spinosaurus:live look-around} Espinosaurio miró a un lado y a otro. {spinosaurus:face surprised} —¿Amonites? ¿Dónde te has metido? {ammonite:bubble-puff} {sfx:bloop} Subió una burbujita: blup. {spinosaurus:face happy} [happily] —¡La he visto! —dijo una vocecita desde el fondo—. ¡La he visto!
